note: Large all-ages RV resort near the end of Corkill Road in Desert Hot Springs, with odorless mineral hot-spring pools and spas at two clubhouses, pickleball and mini golf. Back-in sites on gravel with a cement slab; standard 30-amp sites take rigs to 32 ft. Many guests stay weekly, monthly or for the winter. No generators. --Claude
summary: Catalina Spa & RV Resort: stored $45 is the 2020 rate; Newbook quotes $68-114 daily (Jan and Jul 2027 alike), weekly $51-66/night. Over the $50 gate but within 40 km of Joshua Tree NP (27 km) -> gateway keeps it. Not a Good Sam Park. 50A full hookups, 482 back-in sites (pull_through true -> false), max 55 ft on Elite Plus. Booking window/max stay 178 days. Google ~4.3-4.5 (~640). Daily nights bookable year-round; snowbird park but not mostly seasonal on the evidence.
flags: PRICE GATE: cheapest real RV night is $68 (30 Amp RV Site Standard daily rate, 2027-01-12 and 2027-07-13) - over US$50. Not a Good Sam Park (discounts.good_sam false); no operator-posted member discount found (the home page cites a 2019 Passport America directory cover only). PASSES on the gateway: Joshua Tree NP at 27 km (gateways.py). The weekly rate ($51/night, 7-night minimum) would not pass on its own.
GOOGLE: about 4.3-4.5 from ~640 reviews (CampgroundViews, Google-sourced: 4.5 from 643; earlier read 4.3 from 641) - above 4.0.

LONG-STAY: 'daily, short term, seasonal and group visits'; daily rates bookable in January and July; FAQ allows stays to 178 days and a blog post covers full-time living. Imagery shows RV pads, not park-model rows. Nightly share not measurable from the pages; not judged mostly seasonal.
NOT 55+: rates/FAQ say 'There is no age limitation on any RV' (rig age), and the resort has a Kid's Camp and Kidz Fun Zone; nothing on the site restricts guest age.
SITES: stored pull_through true (note prose) contradicts the operator ('back-in sites') -> false. max_rig_ft 40 -> 55 (Elite Plus 'maximum size 55''); standard 30-amp sites are capped at 32 ft.
DISCOUNTS: military true (Good Sam directory, derived) - the operator site posts no military discount; left alone.
